name: @codesandbox/nodebox
description: Empty stub for @codesandbox/nodebox. The real package ships under CodeSandbox's Sustainable Use License (non-commercial), which conflicts with our EXTERNAL distribution policy. Sandpack only loads its node-mode client via dynamic import, and the SDK examples only use static templates (vanilla-ts, react-ts), so the nodebox code path is never executed. pnpm.overrides points the real package at this stub so it stays out of pnpm-lock.yaml, node_modules, and any built bundle.
